notes: Table 2: OLS (fixest) of panhandlers per station-visit on WMATA monthly exits for the visit's month/year (passersby.csv already gives Georgetown Foggy Bottom's counts), station-average friendliness (each passerby's highest coded response category 1-5, averaged over all passersby surveyed at the station), shuttle-stop indicator (shuttlemin <= 10), homeless-service indicator (servicemin <= 10), date fixed effects, SEs clustered by station. Variable means match Table 1 Panel A (348.954, 3.112, 0.368). Tables 3/4: donations/hour = donations/minutes*60; dollars/hour = (cash+inkind)/minutes*60; Brown-Forsythe = car::leveneTest(center=median) F; ANOVA = aov F. Attempt-1 (it printed RESULT lines) differed from the final run in two sample-definition choices. Both were changed before the final run without comparing to any reported value: (1) fixest dropped singleton date groups (240/98 obs); the final keeps them (fixef.rm='none'; coefficients identical) since the paper describes plain OLS with date dummies over all station-visits; (2) attempt-1 treated a missing in-kind value as 0, giving 70 dollar observations vs the 67 the task description states; the final treats dollars as missing when either cash or in-kind was unrecorded (3 rows), giving 67. Disclosure: while reading the paper's method sections I saw the unredacted Table 4 sums of squares and Table 3 per-station means/SDs (these were not withheld in paper.txt). I did not use them to choose the specification, though the final dollars sample is consistent with them.
